name: xdev-ai
description: Manage AI accounts, open Claude Code, Codex, and Gemini terminals, and coordinate AI tasks in VS Code.

commands.title: Open API Chat with this Profile
Open Squad Project Settings and Storage
Open AI Terminal with Bypass Permissions

viewsWelcome.contents:
Sign in to Claude Code, Codex, or Gemini CLI. Each account opens in its own terminal.
[Add AI Account](command:xdevAi.addAiAccount)

Add a provider API profile for xDev Chat and Squad.
[Add API Profile](command:xdevAi.addAccount)

languageModelTools.name: xdev_squad_ask
languageModelTools.userDescription: Send a message to the assigned xDev Squad API profile.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use when the user asks to delegate a request to xDev Squad. By default asks Lead for an answer or draft plan. Prefix the message with @Implement, @Review, or @Tests to address that role directly. Pass the user's requested text and context they explicitly included for Squad. This can contact the assigned API text model and cannot edit files or run tests. Present any pending plan with its roles, profiles, and briefs. Wait for a later user request before calling the plan tool to run it.

message.description: The request for the role, with an optional @Role prefix.

languageModelTools.name: xdev_squad_plan
languageModelTools.userDescription: View, run, or discard the current xDev Squad plan.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: View the current xDev Squad plan, or run or discard the specified plan when the user expressly requests that action after seeing the plan. Use the exact plan ID returned by xDev Squad. Run requests require a separate confirmation in VS Code. If the user declines or cancels, do not retry. Show the returned results grouped by role.

planId.description: The exact ID from the pending plan. Required for run and discard.

languageModelTools.name: xdev_sdlc
languageModelTools.userDescription: See the current SDLC stage or draft its result with the assigned xDev Squad API profile.
languageModelTools.modelDescription: Use view to read progress of the xDev SDLC workflow. When the user asks to draft the current stage, first obtain its workflow ID and zero-based step using view, then call draft with those values. Drafting sends the project brief, approved results, and enabled skills to the assigned text API. It cannot approve a stage, edit files, run tests, or deploy. The user reviews and approves results under xDev Squad Workflow.

workflowId.description: The exact workflow ID from view. Required for draft.

step.description: The current zero-based step from view. Required for draft.

xdevAi.claudeExecutable.description: Absolute path to Claude Code on the machine hosting the workspace. Leave empty to detect a native installation or search PATH.

xdevAi.codexExecutable.description: Absolute path to Codex on the workspace host. Leave empty to detect the installation automatically.

xdevAi.geminiExecutable.description: Absolute path to Gemini CLI on the workspace host. Leave empty to detect the installation automatically.

enumDescriptions: Lead's account reviews each finished step; you still start every step.
A passing review by Lead's account starts the next step. Changes requested, a blocked step, or an error waits for you. Merging always waits for you.
xdevAi.squad.approver.markdownDescription: Default approver for new Squad runs. You can change it on each plan before approving. The AI reviewer is the account assigned to Lead and must differ from the step's account.

xdevAi.squad.workerAllowedCommands.markdownDescription: Command prefixes that headless Claude Code workers (Implement and Tests) may run without asking, for example `npm test` or `dotnet test`. Other shell commands are denied and reported in the chat. Read-only git commands are always allowed.

xdevAi.squad.workerBudgetUsd.markdownDescription: Spending cap in USD for each headless worker run (`--max-budget-usd`). `0` turns the cap off.

xdevAi.squad.workerModels.markdownDescription: Claude Code model per Squad role, for example `{ "Implement": "sonnet", "Review": "haiku" }`. Empty uses the account default. A cheaper model for Review and Tests saves usage.

xdevAi.squad.workerTimeoutMinutes.description: Stop a headless worker that runs longer than this many minutes.

xdevAi.squad.syncSkillsToProfiles.markdownDescription: Copy enabled Squad skills into each Claude Code account as `xdev-*` user skills, so workers load them on demand. Skills you installed yourself are never changed.

xdevAi.squad.codegraph.markdownDescription: When the workspace folder has a CodeGraph index (`.codegraph/`), give Lead an excerpt of the relevant code before planning and let workers query it with `codegraph explore`. The lookup stops after `xdevAi.squad.codegraphTimeoutSeconds`.

xdevAi.squad.codegraphTimeoutSeconds.markdownDescription: How long Lead waits for the CodeGraph excerpt before planning without it. A very large index can need 60–90 seconds per query. After a timeout, Squad skips CodeGraph for 10 minutes.

xdevAi.squad.repositoryAllowedCommands.markdownDescription: Extra command prefixes per repository, added to `xdevAi.squad.workerAllowedCommands` for steps in that repository. Key by the repository's path in the workspace or by its folder name, for example `{ "services/billing-api": ["dotnet build", "dotnet test"], "web-portal": ["npx vitest run", "npx tsc"] }`.

enumDescriptions: Open a merge request with git push options when the remote URL contains gitlab; otherwise only push.
Always open a merge request with GitLab push options (self-hosted GitLab under another domain).
xdevAi.squad.mergeRequests.markdownDescription: What **Push & MR** on a Squad run does after you confirm. GitLab merge requests use push options, so no API token is needed.

xdevAi.squad.baseBranch.markdownDescription: Branch new Squad worktrees start from, for example `origin/dev` (fetched first). Empty starts from the branch your checkout is on, which puts that branch's unmerged commits into every merge request.

xdevAi.squad.worktreeLinks.markdownDescription: Paths, relative to a repository, linked from your checkout into each new Squad worktree so builds and tests work without reinstalling, for example `node_modules` or `packages/ui-component/node_modules`. Submodules are initialized in every new worktree. Workers share these folders with your checkout, so keep install commands out of the allowed commands.

xdevAi.squad.mergeRequestTarget.markdownDescription: Default target branch for **Push & MR**, for example `dev`. Empty uses the remote's default branch, then the branch the run started from. You can change it in the dialog.

tools.description: Tool names workers may call, as the server lists them. "*" allows every tool of the server.

roles.description: Roles that get the server. Default: Lead, Implement, Tests.

command.description: Start a stdio server with this command instead of using the one in .mcp.json.

url.description: Use a remote http or sse server at this address.

xdevAi.squad.mcpServers.markdownDescription: MCP servers Squad workers may use in this project, keyed by server name, for example `{ "postgres-dev": { "tools": ["query"], "roles": ["Lead", "Implement"] } }`. Without `command` or `url`, the server of the same name in the project's `.mcp.json` is used. Workers still never load your other MCP servers, they can call only the listed tools, and AI reviews never get MCP servers. Ignored in untrusted workspaces. Manage it under **Squad → Project**.

xdevAi.squad.cleanupAfterDays.markdownDescription: Days after which a Squad run whose work is merged or pushed (with nothing committed since) is cleaned up: its worktrees, local branches, and worker transcripts are deleted; pushed branches stay on the remote. `0` turns automatic cleanup off. Squad keeps at most 10 runs per project either way.

xdevAi.squad.minFreeDiskGb.markdownDescription: Free disk space, in GB, Squad needs before it creates worktrees or starts a worker step. `0` turns the check off.

xdevAi.squad.syncFolder.markdownDescription: Folder used by **Sync with folder** to share skills and Squad memory, usually a clone of your team docs repository. Relative paths start at the first workspace folder.
